lesson: What an approval hash binds. The request hash covers the resolved task input, the plan, the policy, the source lock, the tool registry including each tool configuration, and the workspace root. Changing any one of them produces a different hash, so an old approval cannot authorise a modified effect. Approvals do not expire within a session and are never inferred: an effect runs only when its exact hash was granted. This is why the operator sees the real resolved value at approval time rather than an unresolved reference.
